title: SEKA 2024–2025 model-year catalog, Spear section
notes: Rendered-pixel recheck of the catalog PDF (SHA-256 a9e36c0311028a6fbe1798902f583c899bb66ea040839543951bbcf0f70b5e1a). One Spear section covers RDC and Standard frames: Rapier integrated bar included with Spear framesets, mechanical and electronic shifting, max tire size up to 32c. Size-M frame weights: RDC 685 g unpainted and 729 g in Shadow Black (±35 g, accessories excluded); Standard 775 g unpainted and 860 g in Twilight Blue; paint changes weight by 20–100 g. Seven sizes (five regular, two racing), 0 or 15 mm offset seatposts, and a geometry table identical to the current official page. Rapier 375×100 mm is about 310 g painted, excluding metal parts.
